system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Athletics and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Sailing Lore, River Navigation Lore, Lore of a particular coastline.
system.description: You worked aboard a vessel where an unsecured line could cost a life. Weather and hard voyages taught you to keep your footing and trust the people working beside you.
